input:
Earlier scenes:
很久以前，古代的人很不知道什么植物能吃，也什么植物不能吃。所以很多人常常吃不安全的植物，吃不安全的植物对你的身体有坏处，很麻烦的情况。但是一个人，神农，要解决这个问题。他又聪明又努力，旅行很远找到很多植物。比方说，灵芝和夹竹桃。他一吃各种各样的植物就知道能不能吃这些植物。然后，神农写他的主意。他喜欢植物的味道，特别是花。神农遇到了一个黄色的花，一吃就觉得不舒服。

This scene:
发现了夹竹桃有毒。别人看到他，很快给他吃一个灵芝。神农一吃就觉得比较好。然后，他继续写他发现的信息。会告诉他的朋友哪一个植物能不能吃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 发现了夹竹桃有毒：it is unclear that夹竹桃refers to黄色的花
- 别人看到他：另外一个人，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”
- 会告诉他的朋友哪一个植物能不能吃：也会告诉他的朋友哪一个植物能吃，哪个植物不能吃

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别人：一个人，The word “别人” distinguishes other people from a stated person or group; it cannot introduce an unspecified helper here. [teacher rule: bieren]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 比较好：好多了，In this recovery context, “好多了” expresses that his condition improved from before; “比较好” normally compares one option or state with another stated or understood comparison. [rule: none]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 继续写他发现的信息：继续记下他发现的信息，“写信息” can mean composing a message, while “记下信息” means recording the information he discovered. [vocab list]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 哪一个植物能不能吃：哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃，The original combines a question about one specific plant with a can-or-cannot-eat question. This correction clearly states the two groups of plants he can explain. [rule: none]
5. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 给他吃一个灵芝：给他吃了一个灵芝，This is one completed rescue action, so the verb phrase needs completed-action “了.” [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: “别人” cannot introduce one unspecified helper here; “一个人” is a valid introduction.
“觉得比较好” can naturally mean that he feels relatively better after feeling unwell.
“写他发现的信息” is grammatical and can mean writing down the information he discovered.
The original combines “哪一个” with an unsuitably broad 能不能吃 alternative question, while the correction clearly separates the two groups.
This is a completed rescue action in the event sequence, so “吃了一个灵芝” needs 了.
